sentences.text: AI got the first four digits of a big multiplication right.
We gave Gemini Flash-Lite ten problems at every size, from two digits to ten.
At two digits it was perfect, and from six digits up it got none right.
Then we asked it to show its working, and it got twenty-one of twenty-five right.
So make AI show its working, or check its sums with code.
